title: Core CharacterSheet type + character_sheet store + migration
description: First half of ADR 0011 implementation (eshyra-lupf.14). Evolve the FinalizedCharacter type into a versioned, root-exported core CharacterSheet (keep a deprecated FinalizedCharacter alias so existing consumers compile until the CLI cutover). Add a 0002_character_sheet.sql migration: character_sheet(character_id PK, schema_version, system, rules_pack_id, sheet_json, updated_at). Add a core-owned CharacterSheetStore (createSqliteCharacterSheetStore: save/load/list) that persists the sheet document with binding columns mirrored from the document, validates the document/binding on read, and exposes a pack-match guard. Regenerate the schema snapshot. No CLI behavior change yet. Note: the finalized->live-row projection already exists as importFinalizedCharacter.
acceptance_criteria:
- CharacterSheet exported from core root; FinalizedCharacter kept as deprecated alias.
- 0002 migration adds character_sheet; schema.snapshot.sql regenerated; snapshot drift test passes.
- CharacterSheetStore save/load/list round-trips through SQLite; binding columns persisted; load validates and a pack-match guard is available.
- Tests cover round-trip, list ordering, missing load, and pack-binding validation.
notes: PR #326 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/326). Core CharacterSheet type + character_sheet migration + store. Open for review; close on merge.
